        - 02b_Supporting_Schedules

   - Mileage: $0.67/mile

   - Engagement letters and tax returns: retain 7 years after filing.

   - Invoices and payment records: retain 5 years.

   - Client documents returned: retain copies for 2 years, then destroy per confidentiality policy.
   - All electronic files backed up weekly; physical documents stored in locked cabinet.
   - Destruction: shredding or secure digital wipe; log maintained.

4. IMPLEMENTATION NOTES
   - File structure created and tested on server (access granted to tax team only).
   - Rate sheet distributed to partners and approved.
